scope: Optional private server dashboard documentation and its actual CLI, browser, native-source and user-service boundaries
method: Four independent documentation personas; parent consolidated their findings in a technical-writer role. Narrow follow-ups confirmed all six remediations. This report does not certify unrelated site deployment or replace code-quality review.

actions.finding: A fresh shell without ~/.local/bin on PATH cannot execute the published install sequence.
actions.remedy: Export the installed bin directory before invoking the CLI.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md:16; literal published install/diagnostics regression executes with fresh HOME and minimal PATH, failed before fix and passes after.

actions.finding: Copying the diagnostics block also stopped and disabled monitoring.
actions.remedy: Move shutdown into its own explicitly labelled stop/disable block.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md:96-101,120-126; executable snippet regression asserts no disable call.

actions.finding: Healthy and configuration-error wording conflated collection success, machine health, optional visibility and startup failures.
actions.remedy: Define collection-only healthy, source-observation errors (exit4), startup/argument/token errors (exit3), and optional unknown sources explicitly.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md:103-109; senior follow-up confirmed implementation agreement.

actions.finding: Valid JSON with malformed nested maintenance fields could crash rendering rather than become an observation gap.
actions.remedy: Validate rendered numeric/list/admission shapes before publication and qualify that validation is not exhaustive for every nested audit-schema field.
actions.evidence: scripts/server-dashboard.py validate_maintenance; malformed actions, byte-count and waiting fixtures fail before fix and become explicit degraded Janitor observations after; valid control stays healthy.

actions.finding: Coverage limits could make omitted workloads/storage look absent.
actions.remedy: Document loaded-unit-only inventory,250 per scope,15 processes,root plus allowlisted local filesystems up to30,and100 containers per engine; label container truncation in the UI.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md:63-76; senior isolated rendering verified truncation label and both Node regressions passed.

actions.finding: Never reads arguments overstated input minimization because a container API response can contain extra command metadata.
actions.remedy: Distinguish excluded /proc argument/environment files from extra container fields received then discarded, never published or logged.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md:78-80; selected container-output regression proves Command exclusion.

actions.finding: Four existing cert-watch/log-shipper schema links still fail the strict global documentation-site build.
actions.remedy: Resolve those existing links when maintaining the broader documentation site. Do not treat this report or the healthy local dashboard as proof of global site deployment.
actions.evidence: Strict local builder and prior published docs CI report the same four warnings; this dashboard page adds none.

preserved_reservations: History is in-memory and resets on restart.
Absent optional Podman API access is unknown, not zero containers.
Read-only is a fixed observation surface, not a read-only filesystem sandbox. User filesystem namespaces hide existing supplementary-group socket access; no group or socket permissions were changed.
Global documentation publication remains separate from verified local dashboard deployment.
Planning uses session JSON and SQL under the artifact policy; no root AGENTS.md or constitution was overwritten or invented.

validation.spec_review: PASS, tier-1 satisfaction98/100 after mixed-scope failed-first remediation
validation.quality_review: PASS; reviewer ran8 Python cases,2 Node cases,syntax and isolated CLI checks. Parent additionally ran the literal-snippet case; all9 Python cases pass.
validation.browser: Real enabled service, desktop and390px mobile, auth/fragment removal, live metrics/services/filtering and offline stale recovery
validation.documentation: Published literal dashboard install/diagnostics snippets and existing cron-docs smoke
validation.ruggedness: One current RUGGED review with empirical field evidence

telemetry.note: The run did not instrument the three clocks. Agent elapsed lifetimes are not substituted for active time; no speedup or billing claims are made.
